title: CultranAI at PalmX 2025: Data Augmentation for Cultural Knowledge Representation
findings: The Fanar-7B model achieved the highest zero-shot performance on the Arabic cultural knowledge benchmark. The study demonstrated that data augmentation significantly improved the model's accuracy, with the final fine-tuned model ranking 5th in the shared task with 70.5% accuracy on the blind test set. Augmentation helped the model answer questions on less-documented cultural and regional details, which includes aspects of Islamic culture.
